summary: Comprehensive comparison of three Hilbert system implementations: thomaskwaring/cslib_SKI Classes.lean (maximally polymorphic contextual inference system with SKI abstraction), PR #648 (connective typeclasses + five-primitive Proposition type), and this fork (full two-layer proof system with ND-Hilbert equivalence, semantics, soundness, completeness). No blocking conflicts found. Naming difference HasImpl vs HasImp is minor and resolvable. Waring's abstract Context/ExContext typeclasses and ContextualInferenceSystem are complementary to this fork's concrete approach. Recommendation: coexist in short term, optionally provide bridging instances in medium term.
